svg.text: Tinnitus tracking, spike context, and appointment-ready reports

g.text: 1. Fast daily check-ins capture loudness, distress, sleep, stress, mood, noise, and headphone use.
2. Spike logs preserve context when symptoms change, instead of relying on memory later.
3. Weekly deterministic insights highlight associations with confidence, not medical claims.
4. Exportable audiologist/GP reports turn messy symptom history into useful appointment notes.

svg.text: Positioning: self-management and reporting support, not diagnosis or cure.
